description: This Dart source file defines a network client for fetching news articles from the NewsAPI. It includes classes for handling API exceptions and making HTTP requests, including error handling, request construction, and response parsing. The main class, NewsApiClient, provides methods for retrieving top headlines based on country and category, with configuration and utility functions for managing API keys, query parameters, and error extraction.

classes.name: NewsApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling API related errors with optional status code.

classes.name: NewsApiClient
classes.description: Main class responsible for constructing HTTP requests to NewsAPI, handling responses, errors, and providing methods such as fetchTopHeadlines.

methods.name: fetchTopHeadlines
methods.description: Fetches top headlines from NewsAPI based on country and category. Handles API key retrieval, request construction, response decoding, error detection, and returns a list of NewsArticle instances.

methods.name: _queryForCategory
methods.description: Generates a search query string based on the provided category, supporting broad and specific queries.

methods.name: _extractNewsApiErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a helpful error message from the decoded JSON response from NewsAPI.

methods.name: _maskApiKeyInUrl
methods.description: Sanitizes API key in URL for logging purposes by replacing the key with '***'.

methods.name: _debugLog
methods.description: Prints debug messages in debug mode.

methods.name: _languageForCountry
methods.description: Determines an appropriate language code for a given country code.
